await (async(page)=>{
const out=[];for(const [n,points] of [[1,'18'],[2,'10'],[3,'0'],[4,'5']]){await page.getByRole('tab',{name:'Matç '+n,exact:true}).click();await page.waitForFunction(({points})=>{const trs=[...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')];const row=trs.find(r=>r.textContent.includes('TEST HESABI'));return trs.length===12&&row?.lastElementChild?.textContent?.trim()===points},{points},{timeout:20000});out.push(await page.locator('tbody').evaluate((e,n)=>({round:n,rows:e.querySelectorAll('tr').length,participant:[...e.querySelectorAll('tr')].find(r=>r.textContent.includes('TEST HESABI'))?.innerText}),n));}await page.getByRole('tab',{name:'Ümumi',exact:true}).click();return out;
})(page);
